name: ai-cost-ledger
description: Global OpenAI cost tracking across projects and apps, with daily/monthly USD and INR accounting.

commands.title: OpenAI Cost Tracker: Refresh Usage and Billing
OpenAI Cost Tracker: Connect OpenAI Billing (Admin Key)
OpenAI Cost Tracker: Disconnect OpenAI Billing
OpenAI Cost Tracker: Export Accounting JSON
OpenAI Cost Tracker: Update USD to INR Reference Rate

aiCostLedger.dataDirectory.description: Shared private usage and billing cache directory. Empty uses ~/.ai-cost-ledger. Keep it out of Git. Reload all VS Code windows after changing it.

aiCostLedger.codexHome.description: Codex data directory. Empty uses CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex. Local host only; remote hosts require their own log copy.

aiCostLedger.assumedTier.description: Explicit estimation assumption when a log omits processing tier. Choose unknown to leave such usage unpriced. Does not affect reported billing.

aiCostLedger.usdInr.description: Optional manual INR per USD. Zero uses the dated reference rate. Conversion is not an actual bank charge.

aiCostLedger.billingProjectIds.description: Restrict reported billing to these OpenAI project IDs. Empty includes the whole organization; this may include other apps or people.

aiCostLedger.organizationId.description: Optional OpenAI organization ID for the stored Admin key.

aiCostLedger.billingRefreshMinutes.description: Refresh interval for OpenAI Costs. Only active after connecting an Admin key.

aiCostLedger.rateOverrides.description: Versioned custom rate cards. See README for required model, dates, context threshold, tier and per-million USD rates.
